description:
**Blocked by d06.2 + d06.7 (cursor primitive must exist; Input
emits VCursor). Read deck §8 "Cursor as a VNode" and §13's worked
example before starting.**

The most state-heavy single component in the codebase. ~930 lines
covering text editing (cursor positioning, character classes for
word jumps, kill ring), dropdown (slash-commands +
fuzzy-completion), IME composition, paste handling (large-paste
collapse), history navigation, prompt-style theming.

**Read first:**
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/input.ex` (full file).
  Pay attention to: the struct fields (the conversion's hook-cell
  contents); `handle_key/2` (subscribes via `use_key`); `render/2`
  vs `render_dropdown/2` (two surfaces — the dropdown becomes a
  sibling VFlow rendered conditionally, NOT an inline call from
  the screen builder).
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/autocomplete.ex` and
  `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/autocomplete/` directory —
  upstream of dropdown content; not modified here.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/keybindings.ex` — the keymap
  that Input subscribes to. Use `use_key` with the keymap as
  source.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/clipboard.ex` — paste
  integration; not modified, called from Input's hooks.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/wrap_ansi.ex` — line wrapping
  for multi-line input.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/components/input_test.exs`
  (or similar) — the acceptance bar.

**Target shape:**

  - Single function module `Components.Input` with
    `def render(props, ctx, h)`.
  - Struct fields move into hook cells:
    * `value`, `cursor`, `selection_anchor` → one `use_state`
      cell holding `%EditorState{}`.
    * IME composition state → a separate `use_state` cell so
      composition deltas don't trigger the editor's full
      validation path.
    * Dropdown state (visible?, items, selected_index, filter) →
      its own cell.
    * History (browse position, captured edit) → its own cell.
  - `render` returns a VFlow of:
    * `prompt_row` — VRow of [prompt-glyph VText, value-before-caret
      VText, %VCursor{style: :bar}, value-after-caret VText, suffix
      VText]. Wrapping for multi-line: emit one VRow per visual
      line; cursor goes on the row containing the caret.
    * `dropdown_subtree` (when dropdown.visible?) — VFlow of
      selectable items, styled per theme. Mounted as a sibling of
      the prompt row. Screen root (d06.6) places this **above** the
      prompt row in the visual stack so it floats over the
      transcript.
  - Key handling via `use_key`: the keybinding actions resolve to
    setter calls on the editor cell. Multi-key bindings
    (Ctrl+K, Ctrl+W, etc.) work via `use_key` with key_specs
    matching the `%Key{}` struct shape.
  - `handle_paste/2` → `use_effect` keyed on a paste event
    sentinel that the reconciler routes via `handle_event`.

**Edge cases that MUST keep working (verify in tmux):**
- IME composition (Japanese/Chinese input methods).
- Bracketed paste: pasting >N lines collapses to a marker that
  expands when the user opens it.
- Slash-command dropdown filtering as the user types.
- History up/down restores prior submissions; editing then
  pressing up captures the current edit.
- Word-jump (Alt+left/right) and kill-to-end (Ctrl+K) match
  emacs/zsh conventions exactly.
- Backslash-Enter as newline fallback in terminals without
  shift+enter (per opi-bd5.3 ticket — already implemented; don't
  regress).

**Acceptance:**
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/components/input_test.exs`
  stays 100% green.
- Editor character-jump tests (per opi-bd5.2) stay green.
- Manual tmux validation per the edge-cases list above. Per the
  `feedback_validate_in_tmux` memory: **always run `mix pi` in
  tmux to verify terminal output before reporting done**.
- `defstruct` and `@behaviour Component` (legacy shape) deleted
  from input.ex.
- `render_dropdown/2` (the bespoke escape from interactive.ex)
  deleted; dropdown is a sibling VFlow now.
- Cursor lands at the correct screen position in: empty input,
  single-line input near right edge, multi-line wrapped input,
  during IME composition.
title: Convert Input component (full surface beyond cursor)
